question: Liberty, Equality and Fraternity slogan of ________ finds an echo in the Preamble of Indian Constitution.
solution:
The correct answer is__** French Revolution.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__ Key Points__**

__
 
• The slogan of **Liberty, Equality, and Fraternity** is associated with the French Revolution, which took place from **1789 to 1799.**
 
• The **Preamble **of the Indian Constitution, which was adopted in **1950**, incorporates the principles of Liberty, Equality, and Fraternity as its guiding values.
 
• The slogan was coined during the French Revolution to represent the aspirations of the people towards** freedom, equality, and brotherhood.**
 
• The French Revolution was a period of political and **social upheaval in France**, which led to the overthrow of the monarchy and the establishment of a republic.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mexican Revolution:** This was a period of armed conflict that took place from **1910 to 1920** in Mexico, which led to the overthrow of the **dictatorship of Porfirio Diaz.**
 
• **Greek War of Independence: **This was a conflict fought between **1821 and 1832 **by the Greeks against the Ottoman Empire, which resulted in the establishment of an **independent Greek state.**
 
• **American Declaration of Independence: **This was a document adopted by the Continental Congress on **July 4, 1776**, which declared the** thirteen American **colonies independent of British rule.
